summary: The note describes mie rebus (Indonesian spelling) or mee rebus (Malaysian and Singaporean spelling), meaning "boiled noodles", a noodle soup dish from Southeast Asia. It is popular in Indonesia, Malaysia, and Singapore and is also often called mie kuah, meaning noodle soup. The note is very brief and gives no details on ingredients or preparation.
one_line: Mie rebus or mee rebus, a Southeast Asian noodle soup popular in Indonesia, Malaysia and Singapore, also called mie kuah.
key_facts: Mie rebus is the Indonesian spelling of the dish name.
Mee rebus is the Malaysian and Singaporean spelling of the dish name.
Mie rebus is a noodle soup dish from Southeast Asia.
The dish is popular in Indonesia, Malaysia, and Singapore.
The dish is also often called mie kuah, meaning noodle soup.
